office_does: The auditor runs the county's elections, accounting, licensing and recording offices and prepares the county budget for the commissioners.
race_blurb: Appointed Auditor Sheryl Park, a tax professional named in February after Karen Martin retired, faces retired economist and finance consultant Tim Reeves, who says the office's financial reporting is late and incomplete. Park (prefers Republican) led the primary 43.1% to 36.9% for Reeves (prefers Democrat).

candidates.summary: Walla Walla County Auditor since her appointment in February 2026; an IRS Enrolled Agent and 20-year tax professional who owns a bookkeeping and tax business.
highlights: Appointed auditor Feb. 2, 2026, after Karen Martin's retirement [S1][S3]
Says she is modernizing systems, improving customer service and strengthening staff morale [S1]
Focuses budgeting on internal controls, efficiency and timely financial information [S4]
Would follow the Secretary of State's direction on federal voter-data requests [S5]
Endorsed by the Walla Walla County Republican Party [S2]

experience.basis: Appointed incumbent running to keep the seat and continue the changes she has made since February; her tenure is eight months.

spending.basis: Frames the office around strong internal controls, efficiency and accounting for 'every dollar'; proposes no new programs.

candidates.summary: Retired economist, corporate facilitator and finance consultant running for his first elected office, saying the auditor's financial reporting needs to be timelier and more detailed.
highlights: Says 'something is broken in the Auditor's office' and cites late reports and Workday transition delays [S1][S3]
Proposes actual-to-budget reporting, a public performance dashboard and quarterly 'State of the County' updates [S4]
Would refuse and report federal voter-data requests not authorized by the Secretary of State [S5]
BA and MA in economics and an MBA; serves on the city parks advisory board [S1]

experience.basis: First-time candidate who runs on changing how the office is led ('something is broken'), though he has a long professional career in finance.

spending.basis: Centers his platform on oversight tools: actual-to-budget reporting, performance dashboards, quarterly public updates and 10-day financial disclosure.
